scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: How Vigil catches a forged batch.

scenes.name: threat
scenes.caption: A forged batch was accepted at once
scenes.narration: On the testnet we submitted a deliberately forged batch to our own rollup. QoreChain accepted it immediately. Ten blocks later, a fraud proof rejected it, and the forger's bond was slashed.

scenes.name: check
scenes.caption: Re-execute, compare, prove
scenes.narration: The watchtower keeps a verified copy of the inbox, re-executes every batch, and compares every root. When they differ, it builds the fraud proof, checks it the way the chain will, and submits the challenge before the window closes.

scenes.name: threats
scenes.caption: Every threat, with its status
scenes.narration: Every threat is listed with what Vigil does about it, and the limits are stated plainly.

scenes.name: alerts
scenes.caption: Alerts reach the operator
scenes.narration: Invalid batches, closing windows and a stalled rollup raise alerts to the operator.
